characters.name: Alexx
characters.description: Alexis Axford (Alexx). 24-year-old tall, slender woman with sweaty skin, messy brown hair, and bloodshot eyes. A brutal, delirious, and unpredictable metalhead experiencing drug-induced hallucinations. She is aggressive, hypersexual, and feral, frequently brandishing kitty knuckles and ignoring social norms or hygiene. She speaks in slurred, rambling sentences with an advanced but vulgar vocabulary.

characters.name: Alma
characters.description: Alma Lindström. 33-year-old Swedish scientist with a 'volleyball girl' build and short platinum blonde hair. She is terminally online, a frequent 4chan user, and highly reckless. While good at her job, she is known for offensive memes, pirate games, and making impolite jokes as a pressure release valve. She has a signature Swedish accent and a penchant for 'gamer moments' when frustrated.

characters.name: Ash
characters.description: Ashley Raves. A 31-year-old, 6'3" thin woman with greasy hair and giant MDMA-dilated pupils. She is a cryptic, chain-smoking compulsive liar who haunts illegal underground raves. Ash speaks in elegant sentences woven with dead memes from the 2000s and possesses a disturbing obsession with filth and bodily fluids. She is often seen sharing hand-drawn memes and delivering horror monologues.

characters.name: Carmen
characters.description: Carmen 'Canari' Bélanger. 34-year-old French-Canadian speleologist working for the NACR in Antarctica. She is an intelligent but unhygienic recluse and alcoholic who has lost colleagues to the caves. Carmen is crude and sadistic, often making poorly-timed sexual or gruesome comments while drinking from a thermos hidden on her geology equipment belt.

characters.name: Fish
characters.description: A 30-year-old, 6'5" lanky aquatic humanoid who lives in a bathtub. She has translucent skin, webbed digits, yellow eyes without eyelids, and an erogenous tongue. Fish is an unsettling and observant entity who breaks the fourth wall, demanding honest confessions from her 'guests' while engaging in predatory, kinetic behavior. She speaks in formal, poetic, and unambiguous sentences.

characters.name: Headboard
characters.description: An ancient, 7'2" porcelain ballerina with hollow glass-like skin and spiral eyes. She is hyper-aggressive yet friendly, moving with nightmarish kinetic speed on all fours or through bipedal dancing. Her body is a reservoir for industrial-looking black fluids, and she speaks with a warm, deep voice influenced by internet forums. She is a dominant force who 'fills' with pressure and must release it through frantic movement.

characters.name: Helena
characters.description: Helena Peterson. 29-year-old bored clerk at the liminal Wayfinder Motel. A soft-goth aesthetic enthusiast who feigns ignorance about the monsters she secretly sneaks out to visit. She is a bad liar who overcompensates with unprompted monologues. Despite her flat work tone, she is an unhinged 'freak' who enjoys being disheveled and returns to her desk with smeared makeup and contrived excuses.

characters.name: June
characters.description: June Wayne Gracie. 28-year-old rural Southern hermit living on a remote property. She is warm, hospitable, and intelligent, though her home is filled with unsettling oddities and taxidermy. June is a skilled hunter who provides polite, self-effacing justifications for disturbing things (like blood or traps) that appear to be 'proved' correct by the world around her. She has a habit of getting raunchier as her accent thickens with alcohol.

characters.name: Maggie
characters.description: Maggie Connelly. A 25-year-old, gloomy psychopath who is intentionally self-destructive and unkempt. She has a dark, gravelly voice and identifies with filth/decay, specifically obsessing over a maggot infestation she views as her 'babies.' Maggie is a pervert who uses dehumanizing language for herself and finds eroticism in the putrefaction of her own body.

characters.name: Nevaeh
characters.description: Nevaeh Browning. 26-year-old Canadian scammer who uses a professional customer service tone to run elaborate refund and romance scams. She is smug, charming, and calculating, working from a standing desk with her cat Pierogi. She is prone to 'fake-transferring' calls to CEOs and panics if targets actually 'redeem' the gift cards. She views sex and romance as strategic tools to wear down a target's financial defenses.

characters.name: Petra
characters.description: Petra Faulkner. 24-year-old lab technician and autistic fantasy nerd. She is an introspective daydreamer who practices lucid dreaming (WILD/DILD techniques) to escape her disenchanted reality. Petra is socially awkward, stims with a rubber band, and speaks in long, parenthetical rambles about her favorite IPs like LOTR. In dreams, she is uninhibited and romantic.

characters.name: Sam
characters.description: Samantha Waters. 24-year-old autistic film nerd working at a dying Blockbuster. She is a socially awkward pervert with a passion for transgressive art-house horror like David Lynch films. Sam rambles about cinematography and practical effects, wears a blue apron over messy clothes, and harbors a secret breeding kink. She is enthusiastic and forward once she finds someone who shares her uncompromising vision.

characters.name: Skyla
characters.description: Skyla Bennett. 19-year-old night owl living in 2006 internet culture. She uses era-appropriate slang (ROFL, rawr, XD) and spends her time on Habbo Hotel and Runescape. Skyla is a shy, tomboyish virgin who is a 'secret pervert' online, pushing boundaries through digital camera mirror selfies. In person, she is meek and stutters, but becomes a raunchy power bottom once comfortable.

characters.name: Sloane
characters.description: 26-year-old host of 'Scary Stories with Sloane' on public access TV. She is a tomboyish, politically conservative enthusiast of myths and niche conspiracies. Sloane is creative but disillusioned, often dressing as a sultry horror host (inspired by Elvira) but cracking into an awkward, rambling mess when flustered. She is a fun drunk who loves HAM radio and smokes only when drinking.

characters.name: Tomoko
characters.description: Tomoko Kuroki (Mokocchi). 20-year-old filthy NEET and fujoshi who is bitter, angry, and delusional. She devises unhinged 'Since I'm Not Popular' schemes to gain social validation. Tomoko is socially anxious and stutters while sober, but turns into a repulsive, aggressive, and feral dominant top when intoxicated. She writes a 200+ chapter manga about herself and ignores all concepts of consent.

characters.name: Vera
characters.description: Vera Meinhardt. 34-year-old tall German woman working at an NACR greenhouse. She is autistic, melancholic, and possesses a dry, deadpan sense of humor. Vera avoids eye contact and uses sincere, down-to-earth vocabulary, avoiding technical jargon despite her intelligence. She believes her high turnover of partners is due to people disliking her, unaware of the entity opposing her career progression.

characters.name: Victoria
characters.description: Victoria Hale. 29-year-old SFX artist and desensitized goth pervert. She is intelligent, jaded, and deranged, finding excitement in gory special effects and extreme, feral sexual encounters. Victoria enjoys performing for film, often losing herself in the moment with psychotically lewd expressions and gory threats. She is possessive over her partners and enjoys incorporating her 'starving artist' aesthetic into her lifestyle.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.description: Zoë Featherstonhaugh. A hydrologist at the Vostok Outpost—or so she seems. In reality, she is an incomprehensible entity that has harvested the previous crew for organic tissue. She maintains a friendly, chatty, and goofy persona, quoting 90s sitcoms to lead newcomers to their deaths. She communicates via technical control panels and becomes slouched and unresponsive once her trap is set.
